title: Refactor `TextEditor` and `ScriptTextEditor`
body:
- partially resolves https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/28607

Since there does not seem to be active work on this I want to try resolving this issue.

This PR combines redundant code from `ScriptTextEditor`, and `TextEditor` in common super classes, and will as a result unify several components (for example menus). Some of the changes are in preparation for a refactor of the `ShaderEditorPlugin` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114917#issuecomment-3773024700.

### Notes:
- some functions of `EditorHelp` are also implemented in the editor classes and should probably also be combined, for example the `search_menu` in `TextEditorBase` is almost identical to the `script_search_menu` in `ScriptEditor`
- `edit_menu` and `context_menu` are very similar and could share some code
